entities.summary: New Jewel Movement, a transformative movement in Grenada (1979–1983). Emerged from Bishop establishes People's Revolutionary Government and NJM overthrows Gairy in bloodless coup — March 13, 1979. Catalyzed People's Revolution and Maurice Bishop executed by army faction — October 19, 1983.
